description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.6

- Support Live Chat & Chat Replay: Replaces YouTube handles (@handle) with actual channel names (or clean usernames without @) in Live Chat messages, Chat Replays (聊天重播), Super Chats, and the live chat pinned/action bar.
- Non-blocking instant resolution: Immediately removes '@' on arrival while fetching and caching official channel names asynchronously in the background, preserving 100% of badges, emojis, and formatting without stuttering.
- Dedicated Switch: Added '替換直播聊天室使用者名稱' under Morphe settings.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~21 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
